subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reaction support land as a complete read/event contract with generic `message reactions` queries and persistence, as a narrower plugin hook-only surface, or as live system-event delivery without historical querying?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the implementation shape affects public action semantics, stored reaction data, hook payload privacy, access-control gating, and whether reactions become visible to agents or only plugins.

options.title: Complete Read/Event Contract
options.body: Define one WhatsApp-owned contract covering `message reactions`, historical or persisted reaction data, ordinary add/remove events, privacy gates, docs, and live proof.

options.title: Hook-Only First
options.body: Implement only a `reaction_received`/`reaction_removed` plugin hook first and leave generic CLI/action querying plus historical retrieval tracked separately.

options.title: Defer Broad Exposure
options.body: Keep WhatsApp reactions limited to outbound and approval-specific flows until maintainers are ready to expose reaction data more broadly.

recommendation.title: Complete Read/Event Contract
recommendation.body: Define one WhatsApp-owned contract covering `message reactions`, historical or persisted reaction data, ordinary add/remove events, privacy gates, docs, and live proof.
